description: This file contains the main React application component for a Tic Tac Toe game, including game logic, UI components, accessibility features, and state management.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner in the current game board, returning the winner ('X' or 'O') and the winning line indices.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game is a draw (no empty squares and no winner).

methods.name: getAvailableMoves
methods.description: Returns the list of available (empty) cell indices on the board.

methods.name: randomAIMove
methods.description: Selects a random available move for the AI.

methods.name: advancedAIMove
methods.description: Calculates the best move for the AI using minimax algorithm for perfect play.

methods.name: loadStatsFromStorage
methods.description: Loads game statistics from localStorage or returns default stats if none are stored.

methods.name: useLiveRegion
methods.description: Custom hook for managing live region messages for accessibility announcements.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: Component representing a single square on the Tic Tac Toe board.

methods.name: Board
methods.description: Component representing the game board grid with keyboard navigation support.

methods.name: StatsPanel
methods.description: Component displaying game statistics and reset button.

methods.name: AccessibilityDoc
methods.description: Component providing accessibility quick reference information.

methods.name: ThemeToggle
methods.description: Button component to toggle between light and dark themes.

methods.name: ColorBlindToggle
methods.description: Button component to toggle color-blind mode.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the overall game state, UI, and logic for the Tic Tac Toe application.

methods.name: GameModeSelector
methods.description: Component for selecting game modes and AI configurations.

methods.name: PlayerMarkInfo
methods.description: Component displaying player and AI info based on selected game mode.

methods.name: LiveRegionMsg
methods.description: Component for rendering live region messages for screen readers.
